  DorguCLITicketExpired      1

  note: The CLI records a decline only as a Kubernetes Event, and Kubernetes keeps Events for about an hour unless the cluster is configured otherwise, so declines older than that are not counted here. A refusal because the kube context is protected (DORGU_PROTECTED_CONTEXTS) is local only: the CLI writes nothing to a cluster it was told not to touch, so those are never counted.
